a: Start from the user problem and success metric, not a cool technology.
Cut scope ruthlessly; ship the smallest path to learning.
Add analytics before debating what users do.
Design onboarding to the aha moment quickly.
Returning usage beats one-time signup spikes.
Frequent support tickets are roadmap signals.
Pricing tiers affect architecture: quotas, multi-tenant isolation, metering.
Reduce setup friction so users reach value in minutes, not days.
Ship reliability table stakes before polish-only features.
Saying no protects focus; document why for later revisit.
